finding.detail: Adapter increments calls before invoking native_policy. Root infer may refuse cap/time admission before incrementing report.model_calls. Therefore partial_task.native_dispatch_counters.actual_model_calls can exceed admitted chat requests by one. Completed task rows are not affected by that pre-call refusal.
finding.required_interpretation: Root report.model_calls is authoritative for admitted chat attempts; adapter count is infer invocations unless reconciled. Neither is proof of native execution/completion. generation_records contain only returned complete generation receipts.
finding.suggested_resolution: Record per-episode delta of root report.model_calls separately, or label adapter counter as native-policy invocations and preserve both values.

test_evidence: Parent reports75 pure local tests passed. Reviewer inspected source only and did not rerun the suite.
limitations: Source review is not spending authority, runtime success, physical process/container stop or settled billing evidence.
No independent descendant inventory exists. Direct child reap and browser close are qualified receipts, not complete descendant or billing proof.
Eight synthetic development tasks and eight synthetic acceptance tasks cannot establish broad computer-use improvement, Astra parity or10x performance.
CPU admission must actually complete for exact source before GPU; any changed source needs updated hashes and review.
